input.smiles: Second field of the XYZ SMILES line, for the relaxed geometry. Pass this string directly to MolFromSmiles then AddHs; canonicalize only for output identity, never before embedding.
input.xyz_number_format: QM9 uses *^ for scientific notation in some coordinate values; replace it with e.
input.pair: Exactly two N/O/F atoms in the retained XYZ molecule; QM9 distance is the Euclidean distance between their XYZ positions; RDKit pair is the two N/O/F indices after AddHs.

phase1.embedding: AllChem.ETKDG() (v1), randomSeed=42, numThreads=1, all other defaults.
phase1.optimization: MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mmffVariant='MMFF94', maxIters=200). Keep the returned geometry for convergence codes 0 or 1.
phase1.inclusion: abs(RDKit_Dist_A - QM9_Dist_A) >= 1.0 before rounding; Discrepancy_A stores that nonnegative absolute difference.
phase1.failures: Skip failed SMILES parsing, missing MMFF parameters, or EmbedMolecule returning -1. Record molecule ID and reason separately; no fallback embeddings or parameter changes.

phase2.embedding: ETKDGv3, randomSeed=42, numThreads=1, pruneRmsThresh=-1, numConfs=200; other defaults.
phase2.optimization: MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(numThreads=1, maxIters=200, mmffVariant='MMFF94'). Select lowest returned energy regardless of convergence code 0/1, ties by returned conformer order.
phase2.classification: abs(Global_Min_Dist_A - QM9_Dist_A) >= 0.5 means genuine_ff_failure; otherwise sampling_artifact. Use full precision for thresholds and ranking.

phase3.aggregation: A molecule contributes once to each matching group, even with multiple matches. Aggregate genuine failures only. Each scaffold/group has count, mean_discrepancy, max_discrepancy, min_discrepancy of absolute residuals. Most affected scaffold and top functional groups rank by descending mean residual, ties by ascending label.
phase3.molecule_ranking: Descending full-precision residual, ties by ascending QM9 molecule ID. Phase3 outputs omit molecule IDs; entries use rank, smiles, residual_discrepancy, scaffold and functional_groups.

phase4.distances: d[k] = 8.0 - 0.1*k for k=0..55, in descending order.
phase4.initialization: Start EVERY constrained point independently from an unrounded copy of the Phase2 selected conformer. Do not warm-start from a neighboring scan point. Fresh MMFF94 properties and force field at each point.
phase4.constraint: MMFFAddDistanceConstraint(first_index, second_index, False, d, d, 10000.0), then Initialize(), then Minimize(maxIts=1000, energyTol=1e-6, forceTol=1e-4). Use the returned geometry, recording non-convergence if any.
phase4.energy: After constrained minimization, build a fresh MMFF94 force field on the resulting coordinates WITHOUT a constraint and report CalcEnergy(). Thus reported energy excludes artificial restraint energy.
phase4.quantum_forced_energy: Run the same independent calculation at the exact full-precision QM9 distance, not a rounded grid distance.
phase4.snap: For interior k=1..54 compute C[k]=(E[k-1]-2*E[k]+E[k+1])/0.01. Choose first k in descending-distance scan order maximizing abs(C[k]); report d[k]. This is a numerical curvature feature, not proof of a physical transition.
phase4.snap_energy_drop: Signed E[k-1]-E[k+1] at the selected snap index. Preserve the sign; do not take an absolute value.
phase4.delta_e: quantum_forced_energy - mmff94_global_min_energy, using full precision before rounding.
phase4.heteroatom_pair: Element symbols joined with '-', e.g. 'N-O'; indices used internally are not this field.
phase4.plot: Plot all 56 constrained target distances against their computed physical MMFF94 energies; mark the QM9 distance.

phase5.total_molecules_scanned: 130831, the population remaining after official exclusions, including numerical skips. Distinguish from archive entries (133885).
phase5.top5_characterization: short_qm9_distance_molecules and long_qm9_distance_molecules contain QM9 molecule IDs as decimal strings; <3.5 vs >=3.5 angstrom. Include a failure_mode_distinction explanation grounded in your results.
phase5.top5_pes_summary: List of five objects with rank, molecule_id, heteroatom_pair and the seven Phase4 numeric fields, identical to Phase4 values.

output_precision: Write numeric values to at least six decimal places or full precision. Do not round intermediate coordinates, energies or classification/ranking values.
